name: Innkeeper Pala
summary: On Thunder Bluff’s lower rise, travelers find Innkeeper Pala tending the Cat and the Shaman. She offers a place to rest, cold drinks, and a hearthstone binding for journeys across Mulgore and beyond.

sections.title: Hospitality on the Lower Rise
sections.body: Innkeeper Pala tends the hearth at the Cat and the Shaman on Thunder Bluff’s lower rise. Travelers arrive from the central lifts or the plains of Mulgore. In the common room, weary warriors, wandering druids, and the Horde’s visiting allies can find shelter, a warm drink, and a familiar place to rest.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Pala?
faq.answer: Find Pala inside the Cat and the Shaman on Thunder Bluff’s lower rise, near the city’s main lifts.

faq.q: What services does she provide to travelers?
aliases: can i bind hearthstone thunder bluff
faq.answer: Pala can bind your hearthstone to the Cat and the Shaman, letting you return there instantly. She also sells simple food and drinks to restore health and mana.

faq.q: What is the name of her tavern?
faq.answer: Pala’s tavern is called the Cat and the Shaman. Horde travelers passing through the city’s lower tier gather there.

angles.text: As a tauren returning from Kalimdor’s frontiers, you can find a familiar, welcoming face beneath the towering totems of Thunder Bluff’s central mesas.
As an orc, troll, or Forsaken visiting Mulgore, you can rest at Pala’s inn beside the lifts.
